item.title: Seed grant awards
item.content:encoded:
Oct. 31, 2002
Several scientists at the University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences (UAMS) have received new seed grants thanks to a research endowment created by generous donors.
The UAMS Foundation Fund Board recently awarded nine internal research grants to faculty scientists, using the annual income from the UAMS Medical Research Endowment.
Since the inception of the Medical Research Endowment Awards in 1982, 188 investigators have received awards totaling $1.5 million. The awards are valuable seed grants, allowing individual researchers or teams to collect preliminary data and form hypotheses before seeking major research grants. In this way, the awards are vital bridges between the researchers' initial ideas and major discoveries. Eighty-three Medical Research Endowment Award recipients, with awards totaling $633,751, have generated extramural funding at UAMS of $30 million through fiscal year 2002. The scientists, their research projects, and the amounts of their awards are:
Lawrence E. Kass, M.D., Assistant Professor Department of Emergency Medicine College of Medicine "Emergency Department Breast Cancer Screening Initiative" $7,395
Angus M. MacNicol, Ph.D., Associate Professor Department of Anatomy & Neurobiology College of Medicine The Mr. and Mrs. Sam Walton Research Award "Identification of Cell Cycle Control Proteins" $15,000
Walter G. Hubert, Ph.D., Assistant Professor Department of Dermatology College of Medicine The Murphy Oil Corporation Research Award "Oncogenesis of Human Papillomavirus (HPV) Type 16 Variants" $15,000
Michael E. Petty, Ph.D., Assistant Professor Office of Educational Development "Study of 360o Evaluations for UAMS Residents on General Competency Skills" $4,835
Song Hee Hong, Ph.D., Assistant Professor College of Pharmacy The Mr. and Mrs. Willard Walker Research Award "The Impact of Inappropriate Use of Asthma Medications on Patient Health and Health Services Utilization" $13,980
Jack J. H. Bleesing, M.D., Assistant Professor Department of Pediatrics College of Medicine The Mr. and Mrs. Frank Whitbeck Research Award "An Altered Immunophenotype of B Cells in Childhood-Onset Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Is Linked to Abnormal B-Cell Homeostasis" $15,000
Beverly J. McCabe-Sellers, Ph.D., Professor Department of Dietetics & Nutrition College of Health Related Professions The Herbert L. Thomas, Sr., Memorial Award "Assessment of Stability of Biotin in Frozen Food Samples: A PreliminaryStudy to Develop a Provisional Table of American Foods" $15,183
Alan B. Diekman, Ph.D., Assistant Professor Department of Biochemistry & Molecular Biology College of Medicine "Peptide Mimic for a Human Sperm Specific Carbohydrate Epitope" $12,000
Laura W. Lamps, M.D., Associate Professor Department of Pathology College of Medicine The Ed Harms Family Research Award "Rapid Molecular Diagnosis of Tularemia - A Potential Bioterrorism Agent Endemic to Arkansas" $10,197
